t: Reliable, easy to fit, heavy duty mechanical push button lock. A CE marked 60mm back set tubular mortice latch is included with an anti-thrust pin to prevent unauthorised access through latch manipulation. Stainless steel PVD weather-resistant, low maintenance finish. Supplied non-handed and will suit left or right hand hung doors. Features a code free mode as standard, full size lever handles and is suitable for external or internal use. Neoprene seals included. Supplied with 8mm sprung spindles. Comprehensive installation and code change instructions included. Suitable for use in commercial buildings, hospitals, schools, hotels and leisure, warehouses, industrial buildings and transportation.
